meta.name: track-management
meta.description: Use this skill when creating, managing, or working with Conductor tracks - the logical work units for features, bugs, and refactors. Applies to spec.md, plan.md, and track lifecycle operations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理功能、缺陷和重构的开发工作单元与进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果开发时需要把功能、缺陷和重构整理成有文档的工作单元
copy.tagline_en: Organize features, bugs, and refactors into trackable work units
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to break dev work into tracked units with specs and plans

howto.what: 指导 Claude 按 Conductor 规范创建、管理和完成 track，产出或审阅 spec.md、plan.md，维护 tracks.md；还会更新任务状态、记录提交 SHA、先审规格再做计划，并在任务中安排验证和验收标准。
howto.when: 当要创建、管理或处理 Conductor track 时触发；例如新建 feature/bug/refactor 任务、编写或审阅 spec.md 与 plan.md、查看状态标记或更新 tracks.md 等。

say.text: 帮我新建一个修复登录问题的 track，并写好 spec.md。
say.note: 会按规范创建 track 并起草规格文件。

say.text: 把当前 plan.md 拆成 3 个小阶段，每阶段加验证任务。
say.note: 计划会被改成分阶段可验证的形式。

say.text: 把这个 track 已完成任务的提交 SHA 和状态更新到 tracks.md。
say.note: 注册表里的记录会同步更新。

howto.what_en: Teaches Claude Conductor track conventions: create/manage tracks, write or review spec.md and plan.md, maintain tracks.md, update status markers, record commit SHAs, review specs before planning, keep phases small, and set testable acceptance criteria.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Claude is asked to create, manage, or work with Conductor tracks — e.g., adding a feature/bug/refactor track, writing or reviewing spec.md/plan.md, or updating status markers and tracks.md.

say_en.text: Create a new track for fixing the login bug, with spec.md drafted.
say_en.note: It will create the track and spec per conventions.

say_en.text: Split the current plan.md into 3 small phases, each with verification.
say_en.note: The plan will become phased, verifiable steps.

say_en.text: Update tracks.md with commit SHAs and statuses for completed tasks on this track.
say_en.note: The registry record will be synced.
